item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body of **Salle Ala Ya Hussain** and preserved all 86 Roman verse lines in `romanLyrics`. Verified that the preamble and seven numbered stanzas align verse by verse. Updated the title and right-to-left direction and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

For the ambiguous readings “Maqta E Aadaa” and “Deen Ki Qadd,” I used `مقطعِ اعدا` and `دیں کی قد`.
